name: GuruGuard – Access & Content Protection
author: faizanq

sections.description:
GuruGuard is a lightweight WordPress security and access-control plugin designed for membership websites, online communities, coaching platforms, and premium content creators.

The plugin helps reduce account sharing and discourage basic content copying without affecting the user experience for legitimate members.

Features include:

  • Single active session enforcement
  • Automatic logout from previous sessions on new login
  • Disable right-click functionality
  • Disable text selection
  • Lightweight and performance-friendly
  • Simple setup and configuration
  • Works well with membership and LMS websites

GuruGuard is designed as a deterrence layer for content protection and account access management.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/guruguard-access-protection directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the GuruGuard settings page from the WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Configure the protection settings based on your website needs.
sections.faq:
Does GuruGuard completely stop content copying?

No. GuruGuard is designed as a lightweight deterrence system that helps reduce casual content copying and account sharing.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. GuruGuard is lightweight and built with performance in mind.

Is it compatible with membership plugins and LMS platforms?

Yes. GuruGuard is designed primarily for membership, coaching, LMS, and premium-content websites.
